projects.title: Normal reopen and explicit reset
projects.completeScope: Implement explicit reset vs normal initialisation for the supplied real SQLite notes table; normal close/reopen preserves marker and one seed, reset removes marker.

projects.title: Closed query translator
projects.completeScope: Parse owner, true/false archived and title/id sort tokens only, return parameterised WHERE bindings and fixed order SQL, reject unknown/invalid tokens.

projects.title: Awaited reservation persistence
projects.completeScope: Validate/trim code, await the supplied delayed real SQLite write, return detached saved data and map only the declared conflict error while preserving unexpected errors.

timeline.activity: Confirm the prescribed runtime, package-root working directory and evidence location; record the environment. Software preparation is completed before class.
P01 — Normal reopen and explicit reset: contract and prediction, bounded implementation/investigation, then review and actual evidence.
P02 — Closed query translator: contract and prediction, bounded implementation/investigation, then review and actual evidence.
P03 — Awaited reservation persistence: contract and prediction, bounded implementation/investigation, then review and actual evidence.
One shared genuine bounded Gemini/approved-LLM claim, sanitised input and an independently executed witness; unavailable access remains BLOCKED or NOT_EXECUTED.
Review the current form, export one private PDF and reopen every saved page. A filename or export action does not prove the PDF was saved or accepted.

Student recap: what was achieved, what was learned, why the evidence supports it and the next unresolved check. Renew declarations and export/review an updated PDF if the record changes. Stop any owned listener and retain actual submission status; agree a continuation if review remains unfinished.

continuation_policy: Every project remains required and individual in class. If the institutional slot is shorter than the planned range, agree a taught continuation with the lecturer before the session; retain every project and record unfinished work honestly. A shorter slot does not make a task optional or establish completion.
private_evidence_location: Outside the entire extracted collection: student-owned home-folder WebTech_Evidence/S06
historical_reference_scope: The linked historical full-project guides and forms are read-only context with separate contracts. The filtered classroom unit does not include the omitted full-application runtime or its starter/test trees. A bounded classroom PASS does not establish completion of those historical applications.
recap_prompt: Explain what survived normal SQLite reopen, what explicit reset changed and how query bindings and an awaited write protected their boundaries. State why your evidence supports that claim, distinguish same-process reopen from crash durability and name the next persistence limit to investigate.
recap_pdf_consistency_policy: If the recap changes your form record, renew the manual declarations, export the updated PDF and reopen every page before submission. If review remains unfinished, agree a continuation and keep the record incomplete.
timeline_numeric_values: Lower end of the unpiloted planning range, not an empirical minimum or a completion threshold.
